brief.title: American Express (AXP) Historical Stock Performance Report: 1972–2026
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of American Express stock performance spanning over 50 years of daily trading data, covering price trends, volatility, dividend history, and key market events.
brief.goal: Provide investors with a thorough understanding of AXP's long-term stock performance, identify major growth and decline periods tied to economic cycles, evaluate dividend return patterns, and assess the stock's historical risk-return profile to inform forward-looking investment decisions.

required_sections.title: Executive Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize AXP's overall stock trajectory from 1972 to present, highlighting cumulative returns, the current price relative to historical levels, and key takeaways for investors.

required_sections.title: Long-Term Price Trend Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze the closing price trend across decades, identifying major bull and bear phases, all-time highs and lows, and compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) over the full period and key sub-periods.

required_sections.title: Volatility & Risk Assessment
required_sections.objective: Examine daily and annualized volatility, maximum drawdowns, and periods of extreme price movement (e.g., 2008 financial crisis, COVID-19 crash), providing a risk profile of the stock.

required_sections.title: Trading Volume Analysis
required_sections.objective: Analyze trading volume trends over time, identify structural shifts in liquidity, and correlate volume spikes with major price events or corporate actions.

required_sections.title: Dividend History & Stock Splits
required_sections.objective: Document the history of dividend payments and stock splits, calculate dividend yield trends over time, and assess AXP's income-generation profile for long-term shareholders.

required_sections.title: Decade-by-Decade Performance Comparison
required_sections.objective: Compare AXP's performance across each decade (1970s, 1980s, 1990s, 2000s, 2010s, 2020s) in terms of returns, volatility, and dividend activity to contextualize performance within broader economic environments.

kpis.name: Cumulative Total Return
kpis.description: Total percentage return from the earliest to the latest available closing price, reflecting overall capital appreciation.

kpis.name: Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
kpis.description: Annualized growth rate of the closing price over the full dataset period.

kpis.name: Maximum Drawdown
kpis.description: The largest peak-to-trough decline in closing price, indicating the worst-case loss scenario for a buy-and-hold investor.

kpis.name: Annualized Volatility
kpis.description: Standard deviation of daily returns annualized (×√252), measuring the stock's price risk.

kpis.name: Total Dividends Paid Per Share
kpis.description: Sum of all recorded dividend payments over the dataset period, representing cumulative income returned to shareholders.
